collection.title: Mercedes-Benz C Class Saloon 2009 to 2013 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Mercedes-Benz C Class Saloon 2009 to 2013 (C204) model requires a 24" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Side Pin wiper arm attachment and all of the following blades will fit.
